name: Bodacious Babes: Fantasy
detailed_description:
Grab your sword and ready your spells! Join five fierce heroines on an unforgettable puzzle game quest. Work your way though increasingly difficult puzzles to unluck rewards and treasures.

Adventure through lively taverns, explore mysterious towns, and brave the shadows of dark forests. Battle chaotic goblin armies, uncover treasures, and become the heroes the realm needs. Enjoy the many unique puzzles added, The classic slide, rotating puzzles, Lights on off, time race jigsaw and memory tiles. Beat all the puzzles to unlock all achievements and girls images.

If you've been following the Bodacious Babes series, I think you're really going to enjoy this release. Theres tons of improvement over previous versions. Added a ton of new puzzle variety. The hardmode adds unique changes to puzzles and there is a story line that flows through the game as you complete puzzles. The images have huge improvements in quality but also variety in unique locations and poses.

Meet the Girls:

She's lived a sheltered life. Now Ashley is finally free to explore the world beyond her sacred walls. Wide-eyed and eager, she's determined to experience every "adventure" the big world has to offer.

A sultry member of the rogues guild, Amari will do whatever it takes to get her hands on a gold coin - and she's not above using her charms to get it. Clad in tight leather with a dagger at the ready, she's always scheming her way to the next big score with a wink and a smile.

This fierce warrior is always ready for a challenge, whether she's out-drinking burly men at the tavern, crushing them at arm wrestling, or charging headfirst into battle with a seductive grin. Strong, bold, and dangerously alluring, Scalert proves that she can dominate both on and off the battlefield.

Draped in gothic elegance with an ancient tome in hand, this mysterious warlock keeps to herself while commanding dark magic and summoning seductive demon companions to do her bidding. Behind her brooding exterior lies a dangerous allure that's as captivating as the forbidden spells she weaves.

An elegant fencer from distant lands, Mai carries herself with deadly grace and piercing intelligence behind her serious expression. Always seeking new challengers to test her blade against, she'll cut through enemies with surgical precision - and melt hearts with just a glance.

Adventure through lively taverns, explore mysterious towns, and brave the shadows of dark forests.
